title: 감사연구원 운영규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00006:part:1/1

Article 4 (Selection and Management of Research Projects)
(1) In connection with formulating a research plan under Article 3, the President of the Institute may survey the needs of the Secretariat of the Board of Audit and Inspection and relevant government ministries and reflect the results in the plan.
(2) The President of the Institute may report to the Chairperson from time to time matters which, based on research findings, are deemed necessary to be reflected in improvements to audit and inspection work, etc. <Amended on January 5, 2009.>
